login.title: Parent sign-in
login.subtitle: KidLearn uses your Google account, so there is no extra password to remember.
login.privacy: We ask Google only for your name and email address.

consent.title: Your permission
consent.intro: KidLearn is made for children aged 3 to 6, so a parent or guardian has to agree before a child profile can exist.
consent.collectProfile: A first name, age, grade and chosen avatar for each child — no surname, no photograph.
consent.collectProgress: Which lessons your child finished and how they did, so the app can choose what comes next.
consent.collectAccount: Your own name and email address from Google, so you can sign back in.
consent.neverAds: Show your child advertising, or sell anyone's data.
consent.neverSocial: Let your child chat, post, or be contacted by another user.
consent.neverSpend: Let your child spend money anywhere in the app.
consent.rights: You can read, correct or permanently delete everything we hold, at any time, from Settings.
consent.checkbox: I am this child's parent or guardian, and I agree to the above.
consent.outdated: The permission text has changed. Please read it again and agree to continue.

pin.setupIntro: Four digits, asked for whenever someone opens the parent area. Pick something your child would not guess.
pin.mismatch: Those two PINs did not match. Let's start again.
pin.gateIntro: This keeps the parent area out of little hands.
pin.invalid: That PIN is not right. Please try again.
pin.locked: Too many tries. Please wait a short while before trying again.
pin.notSet: This account has no PIN yet. Let's set one up.

form.firstChildIntro: You can add up to five, and change any of this later.
form.firstNameHint: First name only — KidLearn never asks for a surname.
form.avatarHint: Your child will see this character on every screen.
form.avatarEmpty: No avatars are available right now. Please try again in a moment.

errors.firstNameRequired: Please enter your child's first name.
errors.firstNameTooLong: That name is too long — please use {{max}} characters or fewer.

children.title: Children
children.subtitle: Up to five profiles, one per child.
children.empty: No profiles yet. Add your first child to get started.
children.limitReached: You've reached the maximum of 5 children. Delete a profile to add another.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}'s profile?
delete.warning: This removes {{name}}'s profile and all of their progress, stars and badges. It cannot be undone.

screenTime.title: Screen time for {{name}}
screenTime.subtitle: Set how long {{name}} can learn each day, and when the app is open.
screenTime.limitHint: Once {{name}} reaches the limit, new lessons and stories wait until tomorrow. A lesson already started can always be finished.
screenTime.windowToggle: Only allow learning between set times
screenTime.windowHint: Outside these times {{name}} sees a friendly "see you later" screen. An end time earlier than the start runs overnight.
screenTime.windowSame: The two times are the same, so no window is applied.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: We can't reach KidLearn right now. Please check your connection.
errors.childLimit: You've reached the maximum of 5 children. Delete a profile to add another.
errors.consentRequired: Please agree to the permission text first.
